headline: Weathered Expanse Front Stirs Again
war_summary: The latest ledger finds Weathered Expanse growing busier, with 52 base events in 24 hours against 48 in the previous edition; three came in the latest two-hour watch and 24 in six hours. Its ownership has shifted to six Warden, one Colonial, and two neutral bases, making it the most visibly unsettled line. Nevish Line remains the campaign’s busiest recorded sector at 68 daily events, down slightly from 70, but it posted no movement in the latest two-hour watch and still stands seven Warden to one Colonial. Marban Hollow holds at 12 events for the day, with six in six hours but none in the newest watch; its divided ledger remains six Colonial, one Warden, and one neutral. Linn Mercy likewise remains at 13 daily events, with three in six hours and ten Colonial bases against one neutral. Fresh movement has appeared in Godcrofts and Mooring County, each recording two-hour events, while Farranac Coast and Stonecradle also show recent activity. Kuura Strand’s 15 daily events are below the prior edition’s 17 and have gone quiet in the latest six hours. The coming watch therefore centers on Weathered, Nevish, and the divided central fronts.
